```artifact
Feature: Self-Test Suite for Unit U14_Self_Test

  Scenario: Test accuracy of the O2 sensor
    Given the system is in READY state
    When the self-test for O2 sensor accuracy is initiated
    Then the O2 sensor value should be within the specified range
    And the self-test should pass

  Scenario: Validate blower response
    Given the system is in READY state
    When the self-test for blower response is initiated
    And the blower speed is set to 1000 RPM
    Then the pressure achieved should be within the specified range
    And the self-test should pass

  Scenario: Validate pinch valves pressure response
    Given the system is in READY state
    When the self-test for pinch valves pressure response is initiated
    And the blower speed is set to 1500 RPM
    Then the pressure achieved should be within the specified range
    And the self-test should pass

  Scenario: Validate audible alarm devices
    Given the system is in READY state
    When the self-test for audible alarms is initiated
    Then the audible alarm should produce sound
    And the self-test should pass

  Scenario: Validate visual alarm devices
    Given the system is in READY state
    When the self-test for visual alarms is initiated
    Then the visual alarm should be visible
    And the self-test should pass

  Scenario Outline: Test accuracy of the O2 sensor with different values
    Given the system is in READY state
    When the self-test for O2 sensor accuracy is initiated
    And the O2 sensor value is <o2_value>
    Then the O2 sensor value should be within the specified range
    And the self-test should pass

    Examples:
      | o2_value |
      | 20       |
      | 30       |
      | 40       |
      | 50       |
      | 60       |
      | 10       |

  Scenario Outline: Validate blower response with different speeds
    Given the system is in READY state
    When the self-test for blower response is initiated
    And the blower speed is set to <blower_speed> RPM
    Then the pressure achieved should be within the specified range
    And the self-test should pass

    Examples:
      | blower_speed |
      | 1000         |
      | 1500         |
      | 2000         |
      | 2500         |
      | 3000         |
      | 3500         |

  Scenario Outline: Validate pinch valves pressure response with different speeds
    Given the system is in READY state
    When the self-test for pinch valves pressure response is initiated
    And the blower speed is set to <blower_speed> RPM
    Then the pressure achieved should be within the specified range
    And the self-test should pass

    Examples:
      | blower_speed |
      | 1000         |
      | 1500         |
      | 2000         |
      | 2500         |
      | 3000         |
      | 3500         |
```
